title: UK gene bank access - cis/trans issue.

latest.raw: I've hit the wall with tackling cis/trans issue. Can anyone confirm that UK Biobank has required data?  Access cost is a little bit prohibitive especially if it would yield nothing usable.
latest.html: I've hit the wall with tackling cis/trans issue. Can anyone confirm that UK Biobank has required data? Access cost is a little bit prohibitive especially if it would yield nothing usable.

latest.raw:
You’re free to use whatever dataset or approach works best for your method. If UK Biobank access is prohibitively expensive, there’s no need to use it—other biobanks or publicly available resources may be suitable alternatives.

For example, **All of Us** is available at no cost to researchers, although genomic data require Controlled Tier access and there can be cloud-compute costs. You could also consider Explorer or other appropriate resources.

The important thing is that the method and supporting data you use are appropriate for your approach and that you clearly describe them in your submission. We don’t require a particular biobank.
